answer: Witness-ledge escalation: before payout, each key must park collateral on a public ledge and keep a live signal peers can challenge within minutes. Keys that share a funding grove (same wallet lineage or join-timing cluster) see the ledge size grow roughly with the square of grove membership, so a 100-key farm locks about 10,000x base stake at once. That capital cannot be recycled mid-campaign; a failed challenge burns the ledge for every linked key.
